value: After Row 1 the act1 work does, in order: Frozen Eye then Runic Dome (each its own landing, golden unmoved); the combat part of the 10 'out-of-combat part blocked' relics plus Cultist Headpiece and Spirit Poop, each checked against its jar class, act1-coverage.json updated; then a draft (unbuilt) R2 run-layer spec for the 45 out-of-combat relics. Rows 8-14 after.
